directive.quote: Port the reader's logic line for line (rowsWith, one, the rents_a_host / points_a_name / public-door-placement shapes, the vault-name-only credentials). Replace only its source: file reads and writes become door records reads and writes.

old_copy.deleted_with: the same change that deletes the old door rows reader

targets.note: where the byte copy of the source landed at baseline.commit (a9ee2580, the one move of the remaining old trillion features); 2138b2f4 added the adapted file under do-work/ and 8d3d6cb5 removed this path

preserve: the lease client sends only the row's own find, create, read and remove requests under the row's base, each path matched against the row's id pattern; anything else is refused before any network call
the credential is sent only in the row's auth header and never appears in an error
one lease owns one host and key; asked again with the same placement it answers the lease it holds, and a lease naming another placement is refused
a host with this name that the lease does not own is left untouched; a relabelled host is never removed
a lost create answer keeps the lease's cleanup ownership and removes only the host labelled with its name
a test host has a cleanup deadline within one day, a retained service none; the watcher retries a failed removal
a box the person already runs is adopted at its IPv4 address and never deleted
the receipt is saved before each provider change
allowed_deltas: the receipt is a row of the person's Public door receipts list (read-data/door-receipts.mjs), each save conditioned on the value last read, not a mode-600 file renamed into place
the provider row is always handed in (the caller reads it from the Service connections list), not defaulted to one named provider; hetznerLeaseClient goes with that default
the command-line entry with the key on descriptor 3 goes: the rows in tool-rows.json run do-work/door-tools.mjs, which takes the key from the row's credential mount
the receipt schema name loses its product prefix (after the byte copy at baseline.commit)
banned_substitutions: a credential in a receipt, an error or an answer
a request outside the row's declared requests

baseline.note: the copy commit first named here (1028d8fd5d, which held the copy with the schema-name prefix already dropped) is not in this repository's history; a9ee2580 holds the unredacted byte copy, and the prefix is dropped after it ('trillion.portable-host-lease/1' -> 'portable-host-lease/1')
